# HummingBeing — Coaching & Somatics

> HummingBeing is the somatic wellness practice of Isabelle Claus Teixeira. She is a Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer, ICF PCC Executive Coach and Somatic Coach, with 30 years of human development experience across 9 countries and 40+ nationalities. HummingBeing offers TRE™ (Tension & Trauma Releasing Exercises), somatic coaching, bodywork and mindfulness in person in Singapore and Japan, and online worldwide via Zoom. The aim is to help people release chronic stress, prevent burnout, regulate the nervous system and build resilience. HummingBeing is part of Business and Human Development Consulting Pte Ltd (BHD Asia, Singapore).

Last updated: 2026-09-29

## What is TRE™?

TRE™ (Tension, Stress & Trauma Releasing Exercises) is a body-led series of simple exercises created by Dr David Berceli. The exercises activate the body's natural tremor reflex to release deep muscular tension and calm the nervous system. Reported benefits include:

- better sleep
- more energy
- sharper focus
- greater emotional calm
- reduced anxiety
- relief from stress-related physical pain

## Key facts

- **Founder and lead practitioner: Isabelle Claus Teixeira.**
  - Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer and Certified TRE™ Provider, trained under Dr David Berceli's methodology.
  - ICF PCC Executive Coach, and a certified leadership coach since 2012.
  - Strozzi Somatic Bodywork practitioner and Reiki Level II practitioner.
- **Core offerings:**
  - TRE™ sessions
  - somatic and executive coaching
  - mindfulness
  - retreats and workshops
  - the Global TRE™ Provider Certification, which trains people to teach TRE™
- **Delivery:** in person in Singapore and Japan, and online worldwide. Clients come from Europe, the US and Asia.
- **Approach:** science-backed, trauma-informed and rooted in neuroscience. It works with the nervous system directly, not only the mind.
- **Contact:** isabelle@bhdasia.com · WhatsApp +81 80 6515 1778 · https://hummingbeing.com/book

## Sessions and pricing (Singapore dollars)

- **Free Discovery Call: S$0.** A 30-minute video or phone call with Isabelle, with no commitment. Available globally via Zoom.
- **8-Week Coaching Package: S$2,300.** It includes:
  - an initial diagnostic session
  - 8 weekly one-on-one coaching sessions
  - targeted exercises between sessions
  - a follow-up session at 3 months
  - a focus on leadership, career, stress resilience or personal growth
- **Deep Dive Package: price on request.** 12–24 personalised sessions combining TRE™, coaching and bodywork, including corporate and leadership programmes.

## Global TRE™ Provider Certification (2027 Singapore cohort)

- **Format:** one cohort per year, co-taught by two TRE™ Trainers, Isabelle Claus Teixeira and Simba Stenqvist, and boosted by Internal Alchemy.
- **Modules:** all in Singapore.
  - Module 1: 27–28 February 2027
  - Module 2: 3–4 July 2027
  - Module 3: 30–31 October 2027
- **Also included:** online supervisions and three self-paced bonus programmes (Grounding, Verbal Interventions and Internal Alchemy). Module 1 carries ICF CCE.
- **Full Certification + 2 Internal Alchemy Workshops:** S$5,888 early bird until 31 December 2026, then S$6,688.
- **Module 1 only (personal practice, can be bought alone):** S$1,888 early bird, then S$1,988.
- **Past intake:** the 2026 Singapore intake is closed.
